name: Yukikaze Geneblood
original_name: ユキカゼ・ジーンブラッド
source:
Yukikaze was originally a princess first-in-line to the throne, but after leaving her kingdom, she became supreme commander of the non-governmental territorial defense militia "Barauhl." She can transform into a dragon. Because she was born into the royal family as a princess, she is quite estranged from the customs of the world, but she is always curious about her surroundings. 

Yukikaze is the one who picked up Ichiro, the castaway from another world, in the desert. She haughtily acts as if Ichiro as her personal property, but often gets irritated by him when he won't do what she says.

[From Frontwing's [url=https://www.facebook.com/FrontwingINT/]official Facebook page[/url]]
